name: Spina Bifida / Myelomeningocele - Musculoskeletal Complications
definition: Musculoskeletal consequences of spina bifida/myelomeningocele including paralysis, contractures, hip instability, scoliosis, foot deformity, fractures and pressure injury.

investigations.principle: Imaging is problem-directed; hip/spine surveillance and MRI for tethering are used according to clinical change.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Orthopedic surgery is individualized to improve function, positioning and skin safety.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/neurodevelopmental phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Musculoskeletal consequences of spina bifida/myelomeningocele including paralysis, contractures, hip instability, scoliosis, foot deformity, fractures and pressure injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
